Before you hire

  1. Which repairs require a separately licensed trade?
  2. What are your callout fee, hourly rate and after-hours charges?
  3. Can you send photos and obtain approval before additional work?

Ask for a written scope, itemized pricing, recent relevant references and confirmation that the vendor serves your exact address.
